system.title: Construction System
system.main_title: Technology and Innovation in Our DNA
system.main_description: Our system is based on self-supporting concrete panels, produced industrially to ensure maximum quality, precision and performance.
system.panel_description: The heart of our system is the ribbed reinforced concrete panel. It consists of two concrete plates connected by trussed ribs, creating a hollow core that can be filled with insulating material or concrete, depending on project requirements.
system.panel_feature_3: Electrical and hydraulic installations already embedded.
system.connections_description: The innovation of the system lies in how the panels connect, creating a robust monolithic structure with high performance through joint grouting.
system.connections_detail_1: Types of ribs and connections between panels.
system.connections_detail_2: Cross-section of the connection between panel and slab.
system.production_title: From Factory Control to Assembly Agility
system.production_description: We unite the best of both worlds: industrial precision and on-site assembly speed.
system.offsite_description: Quality and precision guaranteed in an industrial environment.
system.onsite_description: Structure assembled in record time with minimal labor.

process.title: Our Construction Process
process.main_title: From Design to Reality: Efficiency in 4 Steps
process.main_description: The TECHSUS system revolutionizes civil construction through an optimized process that ensures speed, quality and sustainability.
process.step1_title: 1. Coordination and development of industrial projects
process.step1_description: Everything starts with detailed planning. Our engineering team uses advanced software to model the project, optimize panel layout and plan each stage of production and assembly, ensuring precision and efficiency.
process.step2_description: The process continues in our factory, where concrete panels are produced in a controlled environment. Using high-precision molds and automated machinery, we guarantee dimensional perfection, concrete quality and integration of all components, such as ducts and openings.
process.step3_description: After curing and rigorous quality control, the panels are carefully loaded onto special vehicles. Logistics are planned to optimize transport time and ensure panels arrive at the construction site in perfect condition and in the correct order for assembly.
process.step4_description: At the construction site, the magic happens. With the help of a crane, the panels are quickly lifted and positioned. Our specialized team performs the assembly, connecting the panels to form the building structure in a fraction of the time of conventional construction.
process.advantage1_description: Reduction of up to 40% in total construction time.
process.advantage2_description: Industrial production ensures standard and precision.

strategy.title: Our Strategy
strategy.future_vision_description: Our strategy is to lead the global transformation of civil construction, starting in Brazil and expanding to international markets, making construction more efficient, sustainable and aligned with 21st-century demands.
strategy.expansion_description: We plan to expand our production capacity through a global network of strategically located factories, operating in a licensing and partnership model. Starting in Brazil, our strategy includes expansion to international markets, leveraging our patents in the US and China to serve projects globally with agility and optimized logistics costs.
strategy.strategic_partnerships_description: We believe in the power of international collaboration. We seek partnerships with construction companies, developers, governments and research institutions in Brazilian and international markets to accelerate the global adoption of industrialized construction.
strategy.esg_commitment_title: ESG Commitment and Alignment with UN SDGs
strategy.esg_commitment_description: At the forefront of Industrial Revolution 4.0, our business model evolves in complete harmony with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), generating positive impact and meeting the ESG agenda.
strategy.esg_benefits: Beyond economic and scale benefits, our construction method meets the ESG agenda, as it promotes substantial savings in natural resources and consequent reduction in polluting activities.
strategy.short_term_goal_1: Implementation of at least 10 factories in the next 5 years.
strategy.short_term_goal_2: Development of new products and patents complementary to the existing system.
strategy.model_advantage_1: Guaranteed demand from interconnected and strategically positioned factory production;
strategy.model_advantage_3: Economy of scale in inputs and resources;

partnerships.title: Partnerships
partnerships.knowledge_center_description: Our innovation strategy is founded on solid partnerships with universities and research institutions, ensuring scientific validation, continuous development and risk reduction for our investors.
partnerships.research_ecosystem_description_1: We have established a robust knowledge ecosystem through strategic partnerships with the country's leading research institutions. This approach ensures scientific validation of our technology and drives continuous innovation.
partnerships.research_ecosystem_description_2: For investors, this means lower technological risk, greater market credibility and a constant pipeline of innovations that will maintain our competitive advantage.
partnerships.partner_universities_description: Academic collaboration for research and development
partnerships.ipt_partnership_description_1: The Institute for Technological Research of the State of São Paulo (IPT) is one of Brazil's most traditional and renowned research and innovation institutions, with a history dating back to 1899. With more than 125 years dedicated to technological development, applied research and open innovation, IPT has played a fundamental role in the country's industrial, technological and social transformation.
partnerships.ipt_partnership_description_2: Through its work with the civil construction industry, in partnership with research centers and other ICTs, IPT has consolidated itself as a strategic platform for technological innovation in various areas, including industrialized construction systems for housing and buildings.
partnerships.ipt_benefit_2: Validation of new technologies and new patents
partnerships.netpre_partnership_title: Center for Studies and Technology in Precast Concrete (NETPre)
partnerships.netpre_partnership_description_1: Center for Studies and Technology in Precast Concrete (NETPre) at the Federal University of São Carlos (UFSCar) was created in 2004 from a Post-Doctoral Research Program in Emerging Centers by FAPESP.
partnerships.netpre_partnership_description_2: Through the Institutional Technology Collaboration Agreement between UFSCar and the Brazilian Association of Industrialized Concrete Construction (ABCIC), the first laboratory dedicated to the study of Precast Concrete Structures in Brazil was built at UFSCar in 2005.
partnerships.netpre_benefit_1: Research in precast concrete and new materials
partnerships.netpre_benefit_2: Validation of new technologies and new patents
partnerships.fumep_partnership_description_1: FUMEP currently occupies more than 25,000 square meters of built area, space used by its four educational units: higher education courses, postgraduate courses, technical courses and more than professional courses, in addition to high school.
partnerships.fumep_partnership_description_2: The structure maintains 42 laboratories, 11 amphitheaters, noble hall, large library, sports court, two soccer fields, cafeteria, restaurant, outdoor gym with walking track and parking with 1,200 spaces.
partnerships.fumep_partnership_description_3: FUMEP's main attributions are to stimulate and improve teaching and research and to establish agreements with universities and cultural, scientific and business entities in the public or private sector.

market.title: Market Opportunities
market.construction_revolution_description_1: The civil construction market faces a major challenge: the need to build more, faster and with greater sustainability. Traditional construction, with its long deadlines, material waste and low productivity, cannot meet this growing demand.
market.construction_revolution_description_2: TECHSUS positions itself as the solution to this bottleneck. Our industrialized construction technology offers a viable and highly competitive alternative.
market.market_segments_description: Our technology is versatile and can be applied to a wide range of projects, meeting various market demands.
market.residential_description: Construction of houses and apartment buildings on a large scale, addressing the housing deficit with speed and quality.
market.commercial_industrial_description: Construction of warehouses, distribution centers, stores and other commercial structures with reduced delivery times.
market.institutional_description: Construction of schools, hospitals, daycare centers and other public facilities, ensuring agility for public administration.
market.hotel_description: Development of hotels and resorts with agile and standardized construction, ideal for hotel chain expansions.
market.market_dashboard_description: Consolidated data demonstrating the immense market potential and urgent need for industrialized solutions for Brazilian civil construction.
market.housing_deficit_dimension_description_1: Brazil faces a housing deficit of 6,215,313 households, representing 8.3% of the national total. São Paulo leads with 1.2 million missing homes, while 3.19 million dwellings do not offer decent conditions.
market.housing_deficit_dimension_description_2: Industrialized construction is the only solution capable of meeting this demand with the necessary speed, quality and cost control.
market.housing_deficit_impact: The deficit can affect up to 3.7 million people in São Paulo alone, representing more than 10% of the Brazilian total.
